plainTranslation: Obsessive, magnetic, all-consuming attraction. You bond at the root and the pull is enormous - and so is the possessiveness. It transforms how the Venus person loves, sometimes beautifully, sometimes through loss. Failure mode: jealousy, control, and the inability to let go when it's over. Magnetic and bad-for-you can be the same bond - name which one this is, and if it runs on control, that's not love.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
